summary: Examples of b64decode on literals and variables, with utf-16-le encoding, and with urlsafe=True.
questions: What does a b64decode example look like?
How do I decode UTF-16 Base64 output from Windows?

answer_card.title: b64decode examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
lola: "{{ 'bG9sYQ==' | b64decode }}"
stuff: "{{ b64stuff | b64decode }}"
stuff: "{{ 'QQBuAHMAaQBiAGwAZQAgAC0AIABPMIkwaDB/MAoA' | b64decode(encoding='utf-16-le') }}"
stuff: "{{ 'aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucHl0aG9uLm9yZy9leGFtcGxlLTE=' | b64decode(urlsafe=True) }}"
# => 'https://www.python.org/example-1'
```
